scripts.clean-install: rimraf node_modules package-lock.json && npm cache clean -f && npm i
scripts.android:debug: rimraf android && vite build --mode development && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && npx cap sync android && npx trapeze run trapeze.yml --android-project android -y && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: rimraf android && vite build && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && npx cap sync android && npx trapeze run trapeze.yml --android-project android -y && node --env-file=.env scripts/gradle-release.mjs
